# THIS IS THE PARAMETER SWEEP. Each line is one variation's one
# parameter, swept one value at a time with every other parameter at
# its default. `classes` is a fixed-width presence mask per swept
# value: the class's glyph where that class occurred across the 27
# inputs and all components, `.` where it did not. So a mask says
# WHICH kinds a value produced, not at which input or in which
# component — rerun the probe on the variation alone for that.
# A change confined to one input, or a sign flip, shows only in the
# digest, which covers every raw sample.
#
# NOT covered: the accumulate and tonemap passes, and how
# variations compose. Those are the visual regression suite's.
